questions.question: For a good quality cement, the ratio of lime to the total of the oxides of $\mathrm{Si}, \mathrm{Al}$ and $\mathrm{Fe}$ should be as close as to :
questions.explanation:
For good quality cement, the ratio of lime (CaO) to the sum of the oxides of silicon (SiO₂), aluminum (Al₂O₃), and iron (Fe₂O₃) should be approximately 2:1.



This proportion ensures that the cement has good strength and setting properties, as well as resistance to chemical attack.

questions.question: Aqueous solutions of Na$_2$S$_2$O$_3$ on reaction with Cl$_2$ gives:
questions.explanation:
The product formed the reaction is used for chlorination of water bodies. The compound Na$_2$S$_2$O$_3$ gets oxidised by chlorine to form NaHSO$_3$. The balanced chemical reaction is,

Na$_2$S$_2$O$_3$ + 4Cl$_2$ + 5H$_2$O $\to$ 2NaHSO$_4$ + 8HCl

questions.question: The compound(s) formed upon combustion of sodium metal in excess air is (are)
questions.explanation:
The compound(s) formed upon the combustion of sodium metal in the excess air is sodium peroxide ($Na_{2} O_{2}$) and sodium oxide ($Na_{2}$O).

 \begin{aligned} & 4 \mathrm{Na}+\mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow 2 \mathrm{Na}_2 \mathrm{O} \\\\ & 2 \mathrm{Na}+\mathrm{O}_2 \rightarrow \mathrm{Na}_2 \mathrm{O}_2 \end{aligned}

questions.question: Reaction of $Br_{2}$ with $Na_{2} CO_{3}$ in aqueous solution gives sodium bromide and sodium bromate with evolution of $CO_{2}$ gas. The number of sodium bromide molecules involved in the balanced chemical equation is ________.
questions.explanation:
The balanced chemical equation is

$3Na_{2} CO_{3} + 3Br_{2} \to$ 5NaBr + $NaBrO_{3} + 3CO_{2}$
